intro.text: A deputy who helped Wax keep the law in the Roughs.

items.text: During the hunt for Bloody Tan in Feltrel, Barl and Wayne teamed up to search one side of the town.
With Wayne, Lessie and others, Barl usually helped Wax keep order in and around Weathering, though he was something of a rogue himself.
When Wayne left the Roughs to fetch Wax, he left Barl running Weathering, which appalled Wax.

personality.text: Something of a scoundrel, for a lawman.
